name: Aperiodic Tiling with Edge Matching
definition: A method to avoid repetitivity when mapping texcells onto a terrain using pre-shaded textures, relying on aperiodic schemes and separate boundary conditions in each direction.
summary: Aperiodic Tiling with Edge Matching prevents texture repetition by enforcing aperiodic boundary conditions and correlating twin edges to avoid seams, using pre-computed geometric patterns rather than procedural noise.
